title: Traffic light
prompt: a pedestrian crossing traffic light: press the button, the cars' light goes amber then red, the walk signal lights and beeps, then it cycles back; see-through shows the controller cabinet, relays, LED modules and the push-button wiring
blurb: Press the button and follow the signal down the pole to the roadside cabinet, where relays switch the cars to amber and red and light the bleeping green man.
